title: RuntimeSensorPolicy
description: The configuration runtime sensors enroll with and keep pulling: mode, hold, rule feeds, forwarding and tamper protection, and which people or MDM systems it applies to. It is a sensor provisioning profile. A device takes the enabled profile with the highest priority that matches it, and picks up a change on its next config pull. Sensors configured by hand with an ApiKey do not read profiles; a person changes their mode from the console. A profile with enrolled devices cannot be deleted.

priority.description: Highest wins when several profiles match a device; ties go to the oldest.

match.description: Who enrolls with this profile: a person by exact email or email domain (* for everyone), or a device an MDM integration enrolls.

credentialMode.description: The credential an enrolled device gets. device-key: a key that works on the sensor routes only, of which the server keeps a hash. user-key: the enrolling person's. org-key: the organization's.

mode.description: monitor: report matches, block nothing. guard: hold a match on a rule safe to block (a request denied, an exec refused, a connection dropped) until a person confirms a block or marks a false positive, or the hold lapses; an action that cannot be undone is never held. enforce: block every match on a block-mode rule, a running process included. In every mode a rule from a feed whose signature does not verify only detects.

hold.description: How long guard mode holds a match, as a Go duration from 1s to 24h.

feeds.description: The feeds the sensor pulls: a DetectionRuleFeed by name, which the server resolves to its published URL; one of the organization's own indicator feeds, by uuid; or an https URL, which must be a published Vulnetix rule feed (https://vulnetix.com/feeds/<org>/<feed>) or a feed in the sensor feed catalogue. Left out, the profile pulls the catalogue's default feeds; an empty list pulls none.

feedRef.description: The metadata.name of a published DetectionRuleFeed.

sensorFeed.description: One of the organization's own indicator feeds (SensorFeed), by uuid.

feedKey.description: The base64 Ed25519 public key feed manifests must be signed with. Left out, the sensor's built-in key.

forward.description: siem: send every DNS and egress decision to Guardian as dns_events and net_events rows.

inventoryEvery.description: How often the sensor reports the packages on its host, installed and loaded by a running process, as a Go duration from 1m to 168h.

protection.description: How hard the install resists being stopped or removed on the host. standard: a plain service. hardened: a guard restores a sensor that was stopped, disabled or masked, and the user cannot stop it unless allowUserStop. locked: as hardened, and uninstalling needs a one-time code from the console.

allowUserStop.description: Let the device's user stop the sensor.

heartbeatAlertMinutes.description: Alert when an enrolled sensor has been silent this long.

autoUpdate.description: Let enrolled sensors install new CLI releases themselves. The guard checks the latest release about every 6 hours, verifies its checksum, keeps the previous binary as .prev and restarts onto the new one. false holds a sensor on its installed version, for hosts that take releases on a change window.

allowMajorUpdate.description: Let enrolled sensors take a release with a higher major version. Off by default: a major release can change the profile format, the units and the protocol, so a sensor stays on its major version until the profile says otherwise. Has no effect when autoUpdate is false.
